text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Parcae was right. I won. I did it, but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (It wasn't supposed to be like this!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(There was a pattern that would lead to
definite
victory, but I managed to win
without staying on
the optimal route.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Which means...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Air Shakur left already? But this is
the
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Isn't she happy she won? Dang... What a
shocker.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something about today's results must
have defied
her expectations—and
Parcae's calculations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurry after Air Shakur and find her
hunched
quietly over her computer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Siiigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's changed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The answer's changed yet again.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The seven-centimeter gap has shrunk
down to
three.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just three more centimeters... Just three more measly centimeters... If I can get this down to zero...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. Look at me, gettin' all carried
away.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This only means the number for the
optimal route
has decreased.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It still hasn't gone down to zero. And
even though
I won here at the Satsuki
Sho, I could still go on
to lose the
Japanese Derby and Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For all I know, this could be a dead end.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First, I gotta hit the target numbers
that'll have
me lose by seven
centimeters, then I have to find
the
variable that'll shrink that gap to zero...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Go on back without me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur leaves before I can get in a
word. She
probably wants to work
somewhere quiet.
Meanwhile, a nearby
conversation catches my
attention.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that just now? I guess that's
how she
always is... totally full of herself.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she didn't give us fans a second
glance,
even though everyone was
clapping and cheering
for her. Some star
she is, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Closing this seven-centimeter gap'll
snuff out
the noise.
choice_data_list: （……いや、口を挟むべきじゃない）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain Air Shakur will perform
spectacularly
at the Japanese Derby.
And when that happens,
I'm sure
everyone's opinion on her will change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as she keeps claiming victories
in big
races, the fans will come around.
choice_data_list: （何より、エアシャカールの強さは本物だ）

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Are things really changing?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I don't get those crappy nightmares
anymore.
That's all over—it's a new start
from here on
out...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I've only got three centimeters to go. If
I can just
shrink that down to zero...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But what if three centimeters is the
closest I'll
ever get?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if all this does is delay the
inevitable and
make me get my hopes
up for nothin'?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Rrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No... I'm being ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Think. Think! Rack your brain for an answer. The goddess of victory still eludes me, but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes to chase her
down!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just you wait for the Japanese Derby!
